posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Well, I can confirm that sending questions in the form of limericks makes it more likely that they’ll get answered.  

Admittedly, my non-limerick question which wasn't answered was about if Setback had preferences amongst the damage types.  So it was kind of silly in the first place.

 

I feel like a Setback/Expat date night generally turns into a slapstick comedy adventure where everything goes horribly and/or entertainingly wrong, but somehow manages to resolve into a sweet moment between them at the end.

 

Also, I think I really want to see more of Setback's sister.  I'm not sure why, other than the fact that I think Setback is the first character to have a confirmed sibling other than Truth and Dare.
